mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the optical parts was most worthwhile because the resulting ray diagram connects the corneas, lenses and irises to their roles in getting light to the retina. The description is clear, though the planned illustration has not been tested.

leastWorthwhile.text: The individual front fittings were straightforward but somewhat repetitive; their shared result explained more than the separate slotting messages.

surprise.text: I expected to attach the eye-moving muscles before joining the eyes to the body. The compatibility feedback revealed the required order and completed the body connection automatically.

arbitrary.text: That required order felt a little arbitrary: the item descriptions did not make it clear why the eyes had to join the body before the muscles could be added.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it continued linking structures to how the body works. The distinction between light entering the eye and nerve signals leaving it was especially useful, although the repeated fittings made some decisions predictable.
